Run after 1.1. This file reads saved QC results and creates PNG/PDF plots in `QC/plots`; it does not read evidence or repeat quantification.

```{r setup}
source("CoPPRA_config.R", local = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(grid)
```


# Read saved QC results



```{r read_qc}
paths <- stage_paths("QC")
plot_folder <- paths$plots
qc <- readRDS(file.path(paths$data, "QC_plot_data.rds"))
list2env(qc, envir = environment())
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 14) + theme(
  plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 16), axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")))
```

# Peptide intensity distributions



```{r intensity_plot, fig.width=18, fig.height=7}
int_plot <- merge(
  pep_run[, .(
    Raw.file,
    Log2_intensity = log2(Peptide_intensity)
  )],
  runs[, .(Raw.file, Condition, Bio_rep)],
  by = "Raw.file"
)

p_intensity <- ggplot(
  int_plot,
  aes(
    x = factor(Bio_rep, levels = 1:3),
    y = Log2_intensity,
    fill = Condition
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.72, outlier.size = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~Condition, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Peptide Intensity Distributions",
    x = "Biological replicate",
    y = "log2 peptide intensity"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p_intensity)
save_plot(p_intensity, "QC_peptide_intensity_boxplot", 10, 4)
```

# Coverage



```{r coverage_plot, fig.width=18, fig.height=9}
cov_plot <- rbindlist(list(
  run_cov[, .(
    Condition,
    Bio_rep,
    Metric = "Peptides",
    Coverage = Unique_peptides
  )],
  run_cov[, .(
    Condition,
    Bio_rep,
    Metric = "Protein groups",
    Coverage = Leading_protein_groups
  )]
))
cov_plot[, Metric := factor(
  Metric,
  levels = c("Peptides", "Protein groups")
)]

p_coverage <- ggplot(
  cov_plot,
  aes(
    x = factor(Bio_rep, levels = 1:3),
    y = Coverage,
    fill = Condition
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.72) +
  facet_grid(Metric ~ Condition, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Peptide and Protein Coverage",
    x = "Biological replicate",
    y = "Distinct identifications"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p_coverage)
save_plot(p_coverage, "QC_coverage_boxplot", 10, 5)
```

# Missingness



```{r missingness_plot, fig.width=18, fig.height=7}
p_missingness <- ggplot(
  run_cov,
  aes(
    x = factor(Raw.file, levels = raw_order),
    y = 100 * Peptide_missingness,
    fill = Condition
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Peptide-level Missingness by Technical Run",
    x = "Technical run",
    y = "Missing peptide values (%)",
    fill = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 12,
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 0.5
    )
  )

print(p_missingness)
save_plot(p_missingness, "QC_peptide_missingness_by_raw_file", 10, 4)
```

# Technical correlations



```{r technical_heatmap, fig.width=20, fig.height=18}
run_annotation <- data.frame(
  Sample = runs$Experiment,
  Condition = as.character(runs$Condition),
  Tech_run = factor(runs$Tech_rep),
  row.names = runs$Raw.file
)

make_heatmap <- function(
    matrix, order, annotation, title, angle, show_names = TRUE) {
  heatmap <- pheatmap(
    matrix[order, order],
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    annotation_row = annotation[order, , drop = FALSE],
    annotation_col = annotation[order, , drop = FALSE],
    annotation_colors = list(Condition = condition_colors),
    border_color = NA,
    fontsize = 18,
    fontsize_row = 16,
    fontsize_col = 16,
    show_rownames = show_names,
    show_colnames = show_names,
    angle_col = angle,
    main = title,
    silent = TRUE
  )

  title_row <- which(heatmap$gtable$layout$name == "main")
  heatmap$gtable$grobs[[title_row]]$gp$fontsize <- 20

  # Move legends downward by 10% of the plot height
  legend_rows <- which(
    heatmap$gtable$layout$name %in% c("legend", "annotation_legend")
  )

  for (i in legend_rows) {
    heatmap$gtable$grobs[[i]] <- grobTree(
      heatmap$gtable$grobs[[i]],
      vp = viewport(y = unit(0.4, "npc"))
    )
  }

  heatmap
}

run_heatmap <- make_heatmap(
  run_cor,
  raw_order,
  run_annotation,
  "Pearson Correlation among Technical Runs",
  "90",
  FALSE
)

grid.newpage()
grid.draw(run_heatmap$gtable)

save_plot(
  run_heatmap$gtable,
  "QC_Pearson_correlation_technical_runs",
  9,
  8
)
```

# Biological correlations



```{r sample_heatmap, fig.width=12, fig.height=11}
sample_annotation <- data.frame(
  Condition = as.character(samples$Condition),
  Biological_replicate = factor(samples$Bio_rep),
  row.names = samples$Experiment
)

sample_heatmap <- make_heatmap(
  sample_cor,
  sample_order,
  sample_annotation,
  "Pearson Correlation among Samples",
  "45"
)

grid.newpage()
grid.draw(sample_heatmap$gtable)
save_plot(
  sample_heatmap$gtable,
  "QC_Pearson_correlation_samples",
  8,
  7
)
```
